usedFor: DitCal holds bookings and Brevo holds email lists, so “New Booking” can add the booker through “Add Contacts To List”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in DitCal, then “Add Contacts To List” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: A new booking is a confirmed lead, and the action puts that contact on a chosen Brevo list.

watchOut: “Add Contacts To List” works on existing contacts only, so create the contact in Brevo first.
